app.name: SHIFTY
app.oneLiner: A person who works long, irregular shifts clocks in and out with one tap, sees net time against a 16h goal live, and gets honest per-day reports and a companion that rewards healthy logging.

users.notes: Installed iPhone PWA mid-shift; desktop for insights; sessions often cross midnight
Each sees only their own shifts

fields.name: reporting_timezone
fields.notes: IANA; device timezone at first launch, fallback Africa/Dar_es_Salaam (A03)

fields.name: goal_net_ms
fields.notes: default 57600000 (16h net); a goal, not a limit

fields.name: id
fields.notes: generated on the device at clock-in; same id on every device and the server

fields.name: started_at
fields.notes: tap time; never moved by location capture (R05)

fields.name: hourly_rate_minor
fields.notes: only when pay tracking is on

fields.name: pay_currency
fields.notes: ISO 4217; required when hourly_rate_minor is set

fields.name: net_ms
fields.notes: derived by the reducer on commit

fields.name: break_ms
fields.notes: derived by the reducer on commit

fields.name: revision
fields.notes: bumped on every commit; base for conflict checks

fields.name: deleted_at
fields.notes: set = in trash (A09); purge = hard delete + session_purged tombstone event

fields.name: ended_at
fields.notes: null while running; one open break per session

fields.name: position
fields.notes: present only when outcome = captured (CHECK); never guessed

fields.name: captured_at
fields.notes: time of the fix or failure; independent of started_at

fields.name: place_id
fields.notes: matched by distance on the device (A05)

fields.name: id
fields.notes: device_event_id; unique; replay returns the original result

fields.name: session_id
fields.notes: target session; null for settings events

fields.name: payload
fields.notes: Zod schema per type; location coordinates redacted on delete (R10)

fields.name: occurred_at
fields.notes: device time of the tap; refused if > 10 min ahead of server time (A15)

fields.name: base_revision
fields.notes: session revision the device saw; stale on a correction = 409

fields.name: previous
fields.notes: start, end, timezone, breaks; never coordinates

fields.name: xp
fields.notes: capped; never scales with hours; negative only for reversal

coreRules.rule: One active session per user: a second clock-in while one is open is refused and the open one is shown
coreRules.test: partial unique index shift_sessions (user_id) where ended_at is null and deleted_at is null; DB double-start test; sync route 409; reducer test

coreRules.rule: Net time splits at local midnights of the session's reporting timezone and the day allocations sum exactly to net (integer ms), DST-safe
coreRules.test: pure engine src/lib/shifts/allocation.ts shared by client and server; fixtures A-O plus property test sum = net; Mon 18:00-Tue 10:00 = Mon 6h + Tue 10h; with a Tue 02:00-02:30 break = Mon 6h + Tue 9h30

coreRules.rule: Every correction of start, end, timezone or breaks carries a reason and writes a session_revisions row with previous and updated values in the same transaction
coreRules.test: commit_shift_events() refuses a correction without a 3-500 char reason; guard trigger refuses direct started_at/ended_at updates; route test 400; DB test revision row written

coreRules.rule: Ends are after starts; breaks stay inside their session, never overlap, and only one break is open at a time
coreRules.test: CHECK constraints; btree_gist exclusion constraint on break ranges per session; containment constraint trigger; reducer tests

coreRules.rule: Location never moves the clock-in start, and a failed capture is stored as not captured with its reason, never a guessed position
coreRules.test: CHECK outcome = captured iff position present; commit function never writes started_at from a location event; reducer test with a fix arriving 40s late

coreRules.rule: Sync is idempotent and never silently overwrites: replays return the original result, stale corrections get 409 and stay on the device as Needs attention, purged sessions are never resurrected
coreRules.test: unique shift_events id; route tests for replay 200, stale base_revision 409, replay after purge ignored; e2e offline replay

coreRules.rule: A person sees and changes only their own tracking rows, admins included
coreRules.test: scripts/check-rls.ts: second member and admin see 0 rows of the first member on every tracking table; outsider sees nothing

coreRules.rule: XP never grows with hours worked; caps per session and per day; the ledger is a deterministic idempotent function of history; corrections write reversal rows; unlocked items and levels are never removed
coreRules.test: unique (user_id, event_key); reward engine tests: 8h and 20h sessions earn equal completion XP, recompute twice adds no rows, correction adds a reversal, level never decreases

coreRules.rule: No unintentional overlap: clock-in, manual entry, import, restore and corrections that would overlap another session are refused naming it unless the person explicitly confirms
coreRules.test: reducer findOverlap shared by device and server; reducer and route tests 409

coreRules.rule: Deleting a location fix removes its coordinates everywhere: the row is hard-deleted and the originating event payload is redacted; later exports contain none
coreRules.test: DB test: no row and no coordinates in shift_events.payload after location_deleted; device log redaction test; export test

flows.name: Track a shift
steps: Tap Clock in; start = tap time, written to the device event log at once
Location requested in the background: captured, or Location not captured with reason and Retry; start never moves
Optionally add note, project, tags, place, pay rate
Active hero: total elapsed vs net worked, goal ring capped at 100% with overage, predicted finish, start date/time/zone; ribbon on every page
Start and end breaks
Supportive rest prompts at 12h, 14h, 16h+
Tap Clock out; end = tap time; 8 second undo
Recap: net, breaks, per-day split, XP, Mochi; optional mood, energy, note

flows.name: Offline and sync
steps: Every action is an event with a device uuid in IndexedDB (Local)
On app open, online, foreground or Sync now: POST /api/sync/events in order (Syncing)
Server re-runs the reducer and commits atomically through commit_shift_events() (Synced)
Replays return the original result; a stale correction returns 409 and shows Needs attention
User keeps the server version or re-applies theirs as a new correction with a reason
GET /api/sync/state pulls changes from other devices

flows.name: Review and correct sessions
steps: Open /sessions: timeline cards with filters and search
Open a session: one timeline across midnight, per-day contributions, breaks, fixes, revisions
Edit start, end or breaks and give a reason
Preview the new per-day split and save
Revision written; reports and XP recompute

flows.name: Add a manual session
steps: Open /sessions/new and enter start, end, breaks, timezone, note
Overlap check against other sessions
Saved and labelled Manual

flows.name: Read insights
steps: Pick a range: today, week, month, year, custom, session
Pick allocation mode: allocate to days or group by start date
Read charts with tooltips and text alternatives
Drill down to the sessions behind a number
Share a recap without location

flows.name: Companion and rewards
steps: Open /companion: Mochi pose and habitat, level, XP log, achievements, forgiving streak
Equip unlocked palettes, hats, decor, backgrounds

flows.name: Data and privacy
steps: Export CSV or JSON with UTC instants, timezone, allocations and audit; print the report
Import JSON or CSV with a dry run and per-row errors
Turn location on or off, set retention, see and delete fixes, manage saved places
Download my data or delete my account

flows.name: Trash
steps: Delete a session: it moves to trash for 30 days
Restore it, or empty trash: hard delete with a tombstone; rewards recompute

flows.name: Device mode to account
steps: Use SHIFTY signed out; data labelled On this device
Sign up or sign in
Offered to upload this device's sessions; nothing uploads without a tap
Sign out warns with the unsynced count, then clears device data

screens.purpose: Home: greeting + Mochi, Clock in or active hero, goal ring, last session, week sparkline (device mode when signed out)
History timeline cards, filters, search, Needs attention filter
Unified timeline, per-day split, breaks, fixes, revisions, edit with reason, conflict resolution
Manual session entry with overlap check
Range tabs, allocation toggle, ring, day-split ribbon, heatmap, weekly bars, month calendar, distributions, records, deltas, places, earnings
Mochi habitat, level, XP log, achievements, wardrobe
Goal, timezone, 12/24h, week start, theme, accent, reminders, safety limit, pay tracking, haptics, sync status
Location on/off, retention, see and delete fixes, saved places
Export CSV/JSON, printable report, import with dry run, upload device data
Profile, password, download my data, delete account
Template team page: invite, change role, deactivate

deviations.choice: Local-first event sourcing: device IndexedDB event log folded by the pure reducer src/lib/shifts/reducer.ts; the server re-runs the same reducer and commits through commit_shift_events() with revision checks
deviations.reason: Clock-in must be instant and durable with no network; one reducer keeps device and server identical

deviations.choice: Tracking routes are a public static shell reading IndexedDB when signed out or when Supabase is not configured; /api/sync/* always requires a session
deviations.reason: A01: no SHIFTY Supabase project yet; the app must be usable on the device meanwhile

deviations.choice: Precache the static app shell routes and /_next/static/**; never API responses or personal HTML
deviations.reason: The clock must open with no network; data comes from IndexedDB

deviations.choice: Local notifications while the app is open plus the Badging API; no server Web Push in phase 1
deviations.reason: A06; a PWA cannot create iOS Live Activities

deviations.choice: Deep ink/navy dark and cream light themes, lilac/indigo accent, big numbers, glowing ring, mascot
deviations.reason: Bill's brief asks for a premium, joyful fitness-dashboard look, overriding doctrine 15 for this product

deviations.choice: Print stylesheet; no PDF generation in phase 1
deviations.reason: Brief asks for printable, not a forwarded PDF; avoids @react-pdf weight

pwa.reason: Clocking in and out happens mid-shift with variable network; server push deferred (A06)

sync.conflictPolicy: Device-generated event ids make every replay idempotent (200, original result); the server re-runs the shared reducer; a correction against a stale revision is 409 with the server state and stays on the device as Needs attention until the user chooses; never a silent overwrite

development.supabase: shifty-dev (not created yet, A01; device mode until then)

preview.notes: Device mode until SHIFTY's own Supabase variables are set; never the pasuax-executive-matrix project

assumptions.assumption: Until Bill creates SHIFTY's own Supabase project the app runs in device mode; it never writes to the pasuax-executive-matrix project
Company tenancy, one org, Bill first admin via ADMIN_EMAIL; RLS own rows only, admins included
Reporting timezone defaults to the device timezone (fallback Africa/Dar_es_Salaam); each session snapshots it at clock-in
Pay tracking off by default; hourly rate per session in minor units, TZS default; no overtime law
No reverse geocoding; place labels from saved places matched on the device
Reminders are in-app and local notifications while the app is open; server Web Push deferred
Rewards are a pure function of history, reconciled with reversal rows; unlocked items and levels are kept
Clock-out undo grace 8 seconds; end time is the tap time
Trash keeps sessions 30 days; the user empties it; no purge job in phase 1
One person's sessions never overlap; overlapping manual entries, imports and corrections are refused
Safety limit off by default; when on (20h default) the session ends at start + limit, labelled, applied deterministically by the first device or server that sees it
Location retention default 90 days (30/90/365/keep), applied on app open and sync with hard delete and redaction
Signing in from device mode offers to upload this device's sessions; nothing uploads without a tap
Sign-out warns with the unsynced count, then clears device data
Events dated more than 2 minutes ahead of server time are accepted, flagged device_clock_ahead and shown; never silently edited
Earnings = round half-up(net_ms x hourly_rate_minor / 3600000) in the session currency
Import accepts SHIFTY JSON and a documented CSV; imported sessions labelled Import
Phase 3 iOS Live Activities is a written spec only, not built

questionsForBill: Credential only (A01): create a Supabase project for SHIFTY (dev now, prod at release) and set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Vercel env and the cloud environment settings (plus ADMIN_EMAIL); this switches on sign-in and cross-device sync. Until then SHIFTY runs in device mode.

chosen.reason: Base team: plans, assigns, integrates; sets up the Vercel preview project and env vars
UI_HEAVY and MOBILE_HEAVY: shell, ink/cream tokens, chart and mascot system, phone nav
COMPLEX_DATA and SUPABASE: tables, constraints, commit_shift_events(), RLS; also the small Auth SMTP/URL configuration
Base team: home, sessions, insights, companion, settings screens
Base team, OFFLINE, REPORTING, IMPORT_EXPORT: reducer, allocation and reward engines, sync API, export and import
PWA, MOBILE_HEAVY, OFFLINE: IndexedDB log and outbox, service worker shell, local notifications, badge, haptics
AUTH, SENSITIVE_DATA (precise location), sync API, public device-mode shell
Base team and OFFLINE: fixtures A-O, airplane-mode and two-device replay tests

notChosen.reason: No third-party integration in phase 1: no geocoding (A05), no server push (A06), no payments or email beyond auth
No custom domain; vercel.app preview and production handled by the orchestrator; CI comes from the template
Single user, no company rollout or handover; README and PRODUCT.md kept by their owners
